decoder: reproduction.obs_loop.decode_parent_pcm -> librosa.load(sr=16000, mono=True) then int16; ffmpeg is absent by design and was not used

derived_from.built_from: the SEALED dev-v1 WAV bytes, each re-hashed against the committed D1 media supplement before it was read; no parent MP3 was opened and no decoder ran
derived_from.id_rule: <call>-<segment>@ts2; the published segment key is recovered by splitting on '@', so the reference layer, the neighbour lookup and the paired join against the sealed arm are all exact and no id collides with the dev-v1 population's
derived_from.rule: exactly 2.0 s (32,000 zero samples) appended to the sealed dev-v1 clip; nothing is removed and nothing is re-decoded

split_role_basis: The SAME 1,500 published segments the sealed 2026-09-05 arm A already read, re-encoded by one deterministic rule from the sealed dev-v1 bytes. No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed: dev is the split this study may optimize on. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded or scored, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, reference layer and derived media root.
